text: Experiment 18 found two marks in the copper that no simple method explains. This round tried methods built to make them: keys of length 7, 21 and 42, Gromark, progressive keys, column shuffles of width 21.
Each dot is the share of a method's simulated outputs that show the mark at least as strongly as K4. A method that made K4 would put both dots well to the right.
All dots sit at the left, below 1 in 20 and mostly below 1 in 100. The marks remain unexplained; only Gromark with base 2 later reproduced the width-21 repeats.
